purpose: Canonical contract for reconciling public-statement evidence into stable Evidence Roots, traversals, discovery gaps, Episodes, Development Threads, persistence tests, dated role/title mention observations, and deterministic reference projections.
ownership_rule: Source ledgers own captured wording and provenance. Existing Bible relation files own comparison interpretation. This manifest owns reconciliation, rooted identity, structural traversal, function-thread, persistence-testing, literal role/title observation, and reference-projection contracts. Generated Root, Discovery Frontier, Episode, Bible projection, Development Thread, and Role Mention files must be rebuilt rather than hand-edited.
root_invariants: Exact captured wording is never rewritten by reconciliation.
More precise time evidence may strengthen a Root without deleting weaker provenance.
Timestamp equality alone never merges statements.
Recovered external status IDs strengthen a Root without renaming its canonical ID.
Ambiguous joins remain open gaps rather than guessed matches.
Timeline order is a traversal over Roots, not the canonical identity order.
Source loading order must not change canonical output.
Episodes resolve existing Roots; they never create or rewrite statement evidence.
Candidate Episodes remain descriptively bounded and carry no interpretive claims.
Bible relations join through existing occurrence IDs rather than quote similarity.
Episode Bible inheritance means member-union only and never implies a sequence-level relation.
Bible relation interpretation remains owned by the established relation files.
Candidate Development Threads use explicit literal terms only.
Every Development Thread attestation records the exact terms that caused membership.
Function threads remain separate from actor/title assignments and carry no interpretive claims while candidate.
Persistence tests measure recurrence and coverage only; passing them never changes candidate status automatically.
A long span alone is not enough to establish distributed persistence; burst concentration and reappearance structure remain visible separately.
Role/title observations record literal dated mentions only; a mention never establishes who occupies a role.
Function-thread overlap with a role/title mention is a reference fact only and never establishes identity, equivalence, causation, or role transfer.

episode_policy.membership: inclusive UTC bounds over existing second-precision Roots
episode_policy.promotion_rule: Theme, Bible, role, or causal interpretation requires a later testing pass and is not part of candidate Episode construction.

development_thread_policy.membership: case-insensitive explicit literal terms with word boundaries
development_thread_policy.ordering: existing Timeline traversal over member Roots

persistence_tests.interpretation: Span asks how long a thread exists; recurrence asks whether and how it reappears; distribution distinguishes spread from burst concentration; support records structural/reference and source-precision coverage.

development_thread_policy.promotion_rule: Broader functional interpretation requires a later testing pass; candidate membership and persistence testing establish only explicit recurrence, temporal spread, vocabulary diversity, distribution shape, and reference coverage in the supplied corpus.

role_mention_policy.membership: case-insensitive explicit literal title/role terms with word boundaries
role_mention_policy.root_index: records which literal mention classes occur in each Root
role_mention_policy.function_overlap: counts mention classes on Roots already belonging to Development Threads
role_mention_policy.promotion_rule: Any claim that a person occupies, transfers, inherits, or is identical with a role requires a separate later testing layer with explicit evidence and counterpressure.

claim_boundary: The Evidence Root records what was supplied, how records reconcile, which literal functions/titles recur, and what remains unknown. It does not establish supernatural identity, prophecy fulfillment, actor-role identity, role transfer, or the truth of theological claims contained in source statements.
